AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.title: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Managed by the AWS client. Access key ID (`AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID_FILE` is not supported, use `AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE` instead)

AWS_ASSUME_ROLE_ARN.title: AWS_ASSUME_ROLE_ARN
AWS_ASSUME_ROLE_ARN.description: Managed by the AWS Role ARN (`AWS_ASSUME_ROLE_ARN_FILE` is not supported)

AWS_EXTERNAL_ID.title: AWS_EXTERNAL_ID
AWS_EXTERNAL_ID.description: Managed by STS AssumeRole API operation (`AWS_EXTERNAL_ID_FILE` is not supported)

AWS_MAX_RETRIES.title: AWS_MAX_RETRIES
AWS_MAX_RETRIES.description: The number of maximum returns the service will use to make an individual API request

AWS_POLLING_INTERVAL.title: AWS_POLLING_INTERVAL
AWS_POLLING_INTERVAL.description: Time between DNS propagation check in seconds (Default: 4)

AWS_PRIVATE_ZONE.title: AWS_PRIVATE_ZONE
AWS_PRIVATE_ZONE.description: Set to true to use private zones only (default: use public zones only)

AWS_PROFILE.title: AWS_PROFILE
AWS_PROFILE.description: Managed by the AWS client (`AWS_PROFILE_FILE` is not supported)

AWS_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT.title: AWS_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT
AWS_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT.description: Maximum waiting time for DNS propagation in seconds (Default: 120)

AWS_REGION.title: AWS_REGION
AWS_REGION.description: Managed by the AWS client (`AWS_REGION_FILE` is not supported)

AWS_SDK_LOAD_CONFIG.title: AWS_SDK_LOAD_CONFIG
AWS_SDK_LOAD_CONFIG.description: Managed by the AWS client. Retrieve the region from the CLI config file (`AWS_SDK_LOAD_CONFIG_FILE` is not supported)

AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.title: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Managed by the AWS client. Secret access key (`AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY_FILE` is not supported, use `AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE` instead)

AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE.title: AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE
AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE.description: Managed by the AWS client. Shared credentials file.

AWS_TTL.title: AWS_TTL
AWS_TTL.description: The TTL of the TXT record used for the DNS challenge in seconds (Default: 10)

AWS_WAIT_FOR_RECORD_SETS_CHANGED.title: AWS_WAIT_FOR_RECORD_SETS_CHANGED
AWS_WAIT_FOR_RECORD_SETS_CHANGED.description: Wait for changes to be INSYNC (it can be unstable)
